meta.title: Giuseppe Milazzo
meta.description: Portfolio of Giuseppe Milazzo, Angular frontend developer based in Pescara, Italy. I work mainly with Angular and TypeScript.

hero.name: Giuseppe Milazzo
hero.caption: Specialized in Angular and TypeScript. Focused on interfaces that work well and feel good to use.

items.title: Vitae
items.subtitle: Personal fitness & nutrition tracker
items.description: Designed and built a web app for tracking weekly workout sessions and daily meal plans, handling UI design, frontend architecture, and Supabase integration.

items.title: GIS Viewer Platform
items.subtitle: Cartographic panel for electrical grid management
items.description: I contribute to the frontend of an Angular-based GIS platform for visualizing and managing electrical networks across multiple countries, within an Agile team. I build new interfaces and redesign existing ones, focusing on user experience and performance.

items.title: Backoffice
items.subtitle: Platform for project lifecycle management
items.description: I led the full UI redesign of an enterprise platform. Starting from an analysis of existing usage patterns to identify pain points, I redesigned flows and interface from Figma to production, and structured the frontend architecture with standalone components and NgRx, within a small Agile team.

items.title: Todo App
items.subtitle: Task management app with Auth0
items.description: A side project to keep up with the latest Angular releases. Auth0 authentication and a mock REST API via json-server.

items.title: Eurosplendore
items.subtitle: Corporate website for a local business
items.description: Led the full process from Figma prototype to production, building reusable Next.js components and refining the interface based on client feedback.

items.title: B&B iMori
items.subtitle: Landing page for a bed & breakfast
items.description: Designed and built the website for a bed & breakfast, from Figma prototype to deployment, with cross-browser compatibility.

about.name: Giuseppe Milazzo
bio: I care about making things that look good and feel right.
Curious by nature, always looking for the most direct way to turn a complex idea into something usable.
Gaming, traveling, and sports fill the rest of the time.

experience.about: Frontend design and development of an Angular-based GIS platform for managing and mapping electrical networks across multiple countries, within an Agile team. I worked on architecture, NgRx state management, and performance.
experience.stack: Angular · TypeScript · NgRx · RxJS · Angular Material · Figma

experience.about: Led the full UX/UI redesign of an enterprise management platform, restructuring the frontend architecture and refactoring core modules to improve maintainability.
experience.stack: Angular · TypeScript · NgRx · RxJS · Angular Material · Figma

experience.about: Built and maintained a back-office system for data management across multiple mobile applications, handling user accounts, roles, and permissions.
experience.stack: Angular · TypeScript · NgRx · RxJS · Angular Material

experience.about: Built the frontend of a web application for the tourism sector, implementing interactive UI components and integrating REST APIs with a modular Angular architecture.
